note: Small private RV park in Langham, 15 minutes west of Saskatoon on the twinned Hwy 16, on the service road beside a gas station, convenience store and restaurants; patio and fire pit at each site, clubhouse, dog park and pickleball court. Also sells weekly, monthly and seasonal stays. --Claude
